answer: A concrete defense is ferrous-tagged provenance. Every identity is stamped at creation with a ferrous tag recording the funding path that minted it, hashed beside its first pearl of real work. When an identity earns, the tag is re-checked: if its funding path crosses another earner's within two hops, both earnings are escrowed until one shows a full walnut-shell audit, a peeled-back disclosure of wallets, devices and timing. A thousand clones sharing one payer form one thick ferrous trace; honest agents walk alone.
